# MediaCodec batch recovery

This revision addresses long-batch decoder state failures and progressive slowdown. Every acquired output buffer is released from a finally block. MediaCodec state/codec exceptions around dequeue/queue operations are classified, the failed decoder/extractor/DSP path is fully closed, the partial WAV is deleted, and the track is decoded once more using a new MediaExtractor, MediaCodec, resampler and DSP engine. Retry never appends to partial audio. Between tracks all converter references are cleared first, then ART GC is requested, every fourth boundary also runs finalization, and a non-blocking 200/350 ms quiet period lets MediaCodec service and ART reclaim resources before the next decoder is created. Forward FFT sharing, fixed FFT plan, audio equations, final cover remux and USB DAC logical-eject behavior remain unchanged.
